statement: SDL's Wii MotionPlus activation on Linux neither sends the A600FE mode write nor updates m_ucMotionPlusMode. On other platforms it performs both. SDL's sensor-enable callback calls that activation, so enabling the gyro on Linux does not itself make an inactive MotionPlus decode-ready. Mode is instead initially learned from the active mapped extension identity during open.

applicability.revision: SDL 3.2.10, SDL 3.4.18 and SDL main at pinned October 2026 source commits; no retail Wii measurement
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. ActivateMotionPlusWithMode 457-468, ActivateMotionPlus 470-481, OpenJoystick 781-785, SetJoystickSensorsEnabled 860-877. This refines earlier wii-gap-sdl-linux-motionplus-kernel-ownership.
